Letters

Nancy Beninati for City Council

Jon Reining · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

To the Editor,

I am writing to support Nancy Beninati for Piedmont City Council.

As a 15 year resident of Piedmont, a local real estate agent, and Head Coach of the Piedmont Mountain Bike Team, I have had the opportunity to see Nancy’s commitment to Piedmont first-hand through her involvement as a parent/coach with our team.

Nancy is smart, hardworking, and dedicated. When she has questions about an issue affecting our community, she asks questions, does her research, and takes the time to understand the full picture. I tremendously respect her thoughtful and responsible approach. I am most proud of the culture of our mountain biking team. A big part of that culture comes from people like Nancy and her family that support and encourage the rest of the community. Culture is built with intentionality, and Nancy knows that full well.

I enthusiastically support Nancy for City Council. I believe her experience, judgment, and commitment to Piedmont will make her a strong member of our City Council.

Jon Reining Piedmont
